rv.q: Robert Hastie, in his final production as artistic director, shows his customary mastery in deploying a huge cast on the vast thrust stage of the Crucible.
Energetic but unfocused revival of Mike Bartlett’s 2012 track and field drama never quite hits its stride
Chariots of Fire is a brilliantly staged show, demonstrating just why Robert Hastie is so well regarded.

cn.t: This Olympic drama impresses with spectacular staging and masterful direction that deploys a large cast across the Crucible's vast space, though the adaptation struggles to fully capture the film's emotional resonance.
